AzureAdCiam._comment: ClientId is this host's own API registration (XD01-390, CIAM model (b): one app registration per API; the Web client requests its scope as GeoAssetsIpBillingServer:ApiScope). The município grant endpoints' ip-billing:reference-manage check is the kernel's answer for the caller's own token (forwarded to the kernel's /api/identity/me, XD01-385), so the kernel must accept this audience: list it in the kernel's AzureAdCiam:AdditionalAudiences (AzureAdCiam__AdditionalAudiences__0=<this ClientId or its App ID URI>). Alternatively (model (a)) use the kernel's API audience here. A kernel that rejects the token answers 502 kernel.token-rejected.

GeoCoreServer._comment: The kernel's ROOT URL (no /api/geoassets suffix; XD01-385 aligned this host with GeoAssets.NeutralOperator.Server). Features (/api/geoassets), the generic organization-grant API and the permission registration (/api/identity) and the caller's identity are all reached under it.

ServiceAuth._comment: XD01-299: client credentials of this host's GeoAssets.ServiceCaller service principal. Disabled (the default) registers no token provider: the kernel's machine-to-machine routes then answer 401 — the município grant sync/revoke fail (500) and the vertical-registration check stays Degraded (/healthz still 200, /readyz 503). Tokens are asked from Instance + TenantId (XD01-452; blank Instance = AzureAdCiam:Instance): the kernel accepts only its CIAM instance's issuer, never a login.microsoftonline.com token.

VerticalRegistration._comment: XD01-385: retry schedule of the bootstrap registration of this vertical's permissions (PUT /api/identity/verticals/ip-billing/permissions; exponential backoff with jitter from InitialDelay to MaxDelay until it succeeds), then republished every RefreshInterval.

GrantSync._comment: XD01-395: the município grant-sync dispatcher. Município saves queue their Prefeitura grant change (MunicipioGrantSyncRequests, same transaction as the save); every PollInterval the dispatcher claims up to BatchSize due requests (oldest first, one per município at a time, held LeaseDuration) and sends them to the kernel as GeoAssets.ServiceCaller. A failed attempt is retried after InitialBackoff doubled per failure, jittered, capped at MaxBackoff; after MaxAttempts failures the request is marked Failed (grantSyncState=failed on the município). XD01-400: every PruneInterval the pruner deletes, PruneBatchSize rows at a time, requests completed more than CompletedRetention ago and, only when FailedRetention is set (null = keep them), requests failed more than FailedRetention ago; a município's latest request and unfinished requests are never deleted (counter geoassets.ipbilling.grant_sync_pruned). Enabled=false stops the dispatcher and the pruner (requests keep queueing).
